heading: Terms of use
body:

Yaqeen Advisory provides accounting, tax compliance support, payroll, reporting and advisory services. We do not perform statutory audit or tax audit. Work that is legally reserved for a licensed practitioner is carried out by your independently appointed professional.

We may link to third-party sites. We are not responsible for their content or practices.

## Limitation of liability

We make reasonable efforts to keep this website accurate, but provide it "as is". To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for loss arising from your use of, or reliance on, the website.

## Governing law

## Contact

Questions about these terms can be sent to the email address on our contact page.
